archive_replay.ownership_limitation: Archive manifests retain bytes, mode and SHA-256; all payload ZIP extra fields are empty. Historical payload UID/GID are not retained and cannot be independently recovered from these archives.
archive_replay.payload_read_method: zipfile.ZipFile.open; read 1 MiB chunks through EOF; independent hashlib.sha256; CRC checked by zipfile

retained_file_identity.scope: Retained ordinary files actually read by this auditor; does not establish retired payload ownership

git_after.qualification_authority: actual pinned source bytes and source contract; commit metadata is not source identity

git_before.qualification_authority: actual pinned source bytes and source contract; commit metadata is not source identity
